recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-32582; if the extension definition needs future adjustment, make that change in the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-32582 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to remove DocumentReference.sourcePatientInfo because this XDS-specific source patient metadata should be represented as an extension rather than a core DocumentReference element.
initial_application: The Jira-linked implementation landed through commit 82d7ae7918d657b4dcd4534d3c244163aca850a9 and merge f2d7b07e50c2811a7ede6ce944f5cb33ecb12a98. That change removed DocumentReference.sourcePatientInfo from source/documentreference/structuredefinition-DocumentReference.xml, replaced the example element with http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/documentreference-sourcepatient extensions, and added the extension source in the DocumentReference area.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps DocumentReference active in the current build and maps the old R4 DocumentReference.context.sourcePatientInfo path to the documentreference-sourcepatient extension. The extension definition has since moved out of the core checkout; /home/jmandel/work/fhir-extensions/input/definitions/DocumentReference/StructureDefinition-documentreference-sourcepatient.xml defines the canonical extension for DocumentReference with a Patient reference value. Confluence OO minutes from 2022-07-12 record the 3-0-0 motion to accept FHIR-32582 as proposed, and no relevant Zulip conflict was found.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current core DocumentReference structure definition has no sourcePatientInfo element, current DocumentReference examples use the extension, and the extension's current source of truth is the FHIR Extension Pack rather than this core checkout.
